about: Tap-to-describe hints, based on Semantic Feature Analysis (group, use, action, properties, location, association). Each chip adds one clue. 'clue' is the plain-English text sent to the model. Rows listed under a group id are shown after that group is picked; 'any' rows are shown for every group. 'cloudFirst' lists the groups where the small on-device model is measurably weak (see docs/ACCURACY.md): for those the cloud is asked first when it can be reached.
